definitions.explanation: watching or viewing something such as an exhibition, show, or event as a spectator

examples.japanese: {展示会|てんじかい}を{観覧|かんらん}する。
{観覧料|かんらんりょう}は{無料|むりょう}です。
{一般|いっぱん}{観覧|かんらん}は{午前|ごぜん}10{時|じ}からです。

notes:
FORMATION:
{観|かん} (view, watch) + {覧|らん} (look at, see) → watch and view

VERB FORM:
{観覧|かんらん}する (to view, to watch)

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {観覧車|かんらんしゃ} (Ferris wheel - literally "viewing wheel")
- {観覧料|かんらんりょう} (admission fee)
- {観覧席|かんらんせき} (spectator seats)
- {一般|いっぱん}{観覧|かんらん} (public viewing/admission)

RELATED WORDS:
- {鑑賞|かんしょう} (appreciation, viewing - for art/music)
- {見学|けんがく} (observation visit, tour)
- {観戦|かんせん} (watching a game/match)

DISTINCTION:
{観覧|かんらん} is a general term for viewing. {鑑賞|かんしょう} implies appreciation with deeper engagement (art, music). {見学|けんがく} implies a learning or educational purpose. {観戦|かんせん} is specifically for sports.
